summary: Factory daemon can remain running at cycle=1 with last_tick_at=null while watchdog restarts the process on its fixed window.
symptoms: factory_daemon.log shows repeated "Factory daemon started" every 15 minutes
tasks stay active but do not produce completed/failed transitions
artifacts remain historically present but no new runtime execution evidence appears
diagnosis: This is not a recovery loop. Recovery remained inactive during the soak window.
This is not an artifact pipeline outage. Artifacts stayed present throughout the soak.
The hidden fault is before the first successful tick completion.
next_checks: Instrument tick() phases to find the pre-heartbeat stall before first completion.
Verify watchdog restart policy does not mask first-tick deadlock by continuously replacing the pid.
